rule: The blob count of this repository must never decrease. A decrease proves a prune/rewrite destroyed history objects (evidence destruction) and fails the history door. Raising the floor requires the deletion three-gate protocol (risk analysis + itemized list + maintainer approval) executed in the same reviewed commit.
context: Initial floor set at the M0 remediation batch. One approved amend+prune occurred BEFORE this floor existed (see docs/PROGRESS.md history-door incident record); the floor prevents any recurrence without a reviewed, approved floor bump.
